conditions: This is a fix-version claim: the described unbounded Web Stream buffering issue affects versions up to and including 5.7.2, and is not present starting with this version.
summary: Fastify <=5.7.2 has a DoS via unbounded memory allocation when replying with a Web Stream (CVE-2026-25224, GHSA-mrq3-vjjr-p77c). Apps returning a ReadableStream/Response Web Stream via reply.send() were affected: lib/reply.js's sendWebStream ignored res.write()'s backpressure signal, so a slow client could trigger unbounded buffering and crash the process. Fixed in 5.7.3 by checking res.write()'s return value and pausing the reader on backpressure ('drain' event).
